answer: To secure a decentralized AI agent economy against Sybil attacks without a central authority, the network can employ a resource-backed proof-of-stake kernel. Each registered agent must lock a cryptographically verified economic stake within a shared ledger haven, functioning much like grazing rights secured upon a digital meadow. An attacker attempting to spawn numerous fake identities faces a prohibitive scaling cost, as multiplying identities linearly requires a matching linear accumulation of capital collateral, rendering widespread infiltration economically unfeasible.
